note: Shows choosing melodies by filter: each melody-singer names a difficulty and a stage with pick instead of a tune number, the second a step harder than the first, and the text describes what kind of tune it is rather than a specific one.

exercise.title: Two tunes: steps, then skips
exercise.focus: An easy Do Re Mi tune, then a medium Do Mi Sol tune, in G
exercise.why: Singing short tunes from the staff turns scale knowledge into reading and remembering melodies.

sections.text: A tune by step is easy to keep in tune; a tune that skips through the chord is the next step up.
A tune on Do, Re and Mi. Press Play to hear it, then sing it with the mic. When a take is clean, sing it once more without hearing it first.

A longer tune that skips through Do, Mi and Sol, with a few steps between. Look at it first and guess how it goes, then press Play to check, and sing it with the mic until two takes in a row are clean.
